en.hubeali:
One of our companions, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Hameed, from Sayf Bin Ameyra, from Mansour, from Ibn Abu Yafour, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘When Al-Tala’a increases upon the third by (even) one Awqiya (a unit of measurement), so it is Prohibited’.
en.sarwar: 9. Certain persons of our people have narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Hamid from Sayf ibn ‘Amirah from Mansur from ibn abu Ya‘fur who has said the following: “
If al-Tila’ is more than one-third even by one ritl (a certain unit of measurement) it then is unlawful.’”
